cue: A proof infers positive renewal speed or finite mean regeneration time from almost-surely finite regeneration times alone
fire_when: The C0041 proof cites tau_1<infinity a.s. as its sole clock-moment justification
silent_when: A summable regeneration-time tail or the needed conditioned first-moment bound is explicitly established
text: A.s.-finite regeneration times need not have finite mean. Name the law and conditioning event, and prove a summable time tail before using the renewal speed formula. A spatial-tail bridge needs its numerical rate.
